| concurrency:  
|  group: challenge-tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}  
|  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}  
|   
| jobs:  
|  tests:  
|  name: Challenge Tests  
|  if: ${{ !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, ':ci skip') }}  
|  permissions:  
|  contents: read  
|  runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}  
|  strategy:  
|  fail-fast: false  
|  matrix:  
|  os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]  
|  python-version: ['3.10', '3.11', '3.12', '3.13', '3.14', pypy-3.11]  
|  env:  
|  QJS_VERSION: '2025-04-26' # Earliest version with rope strings  
|  steps:  
|  \- uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2  
|  with:  
|  persist-credentials: false  
|  \- name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}  
|  uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405 # v6.2.0  
|  with:  
|  python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}  
|  \- name: Install Deno  
|  uses: denoland/setup-deno@e95548e56dfa95d4e1a28d6f422fafe75c4c26fb # v2.0.3  
|  with:  
|  deno-version: '2.0.0' # minimum supported version  
|  \- name: Install Bun  
|  uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@3d267786b128fe76c2f16a390aa2448b815359f3 # v2.1.2  
|  with:  
|  # minimum supported version is 1.0.31 but earliest available Windows version is 1.1.0  
|  bun-version: ${{ (matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && '1.1.0') || '1.0.31' }}  
|  no-cache: true  
|  \- name: Install Node  
|  uses: actions/setup-node@6044e13b5dc448c55e2357c09f80417699197238 # v6.2.0  
|  with:  
|  node-version: '20.0' # minimum supported version  
|  \- name: Install QuickJS (Linux)  
|  if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'  
|  shell: bash  
|  run: |  
|  wget "https://bellard.org/quickjs/binary_releases/quickjs-linux-x86_64-${QJS_VERSION}.zip" -O quickjs.zip  
|  unzip quickjs.zip qjs  
|  sudo install qjs /usr/local/bin/qjs  
|  \- name: Install QuickJS (Windows)  
|  if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'  
|  shell: pwsh  
|  run: |  
|  $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"  
|  $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true  
|  Invoke-WebRequest "https://bellard.org/quickjs/binary_releases/quickjs-win-x86_64-${Env:QJS_VERSION}.zip" -OutFile quickjs.zip  
|  unzip quickjs.zip  
|  \- name: Install test requirements  
|  shell: bash  
|  run: |  
|  python ./devscripts/install_deps.py --print --omit-default --include-extra test > requirements.txt  
|  python ./devscripts/install_deps.py --print -c certifi -c requests -c urllib3 -c yt-dlp-ejs >> requirements.txt  
|  python -m pip install -U -r requirements.txt  
|  \- name: Run tests  
|  timeout-minutes: 15  
|  shell: bash  
|  run: |  
|  python -m yt_dlp -v --js-runtimes node --js-runtimes bun --js-runtimes quickjs || true  
|  python ./devscripts/run_tests.py test/test_jsc -k download

[ .github/workflows/core.yml ](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/e71e35ad3cba13397ab61b6b5751d1272395aef6/.github/workflows/core.yml) at [e71e35a](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/e71e35ad3cba13397ab61b6b5751d1272395aef6)

| name: Core Tests  
---|---  
| on:  
|  push:  
|  paths:  
|  \- .github/**  
|  \- devscripts/**  
|  \- test/**  
|  \- yt_dlp/**.py  
|  \- '!yt_dlp/extractor/**.py'  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/**.py  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/__init__.py  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/common.py  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/extractors.py  
|  pull_request:  
|  paths:  
|  \- .github/**  
|  \- devscripts/**  
|  \- test/**  
|  \- yt_dlp/**.py  
|  \- '!yt_dlp/extractor/**.py'  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/**.py  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/__init__.py  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/common.py  
|  \- yt_dlp/extractor/extractors.py  
|   
| permissions: {}  
|   
| concurrency:  
|  group: core-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}  
|  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}  
|   
| jobs:  
|  tests:  
|  name: Core Tests  
|  if: ${{ !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, ':ci skip') }}  
|  permissions:  
|  contents: read  
|  runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}  
|  strategy:  
|  fail-fast: false  
|  matrix:  
|  os: [ubuntu-latest]  
|  # CPython 3.10 is in quick-test  
|  python-version: ['3.11', '3.12', '3.13', '3.14', pypy-3.11]  
|  include:  
|  # atleast one of each CPython/PyPy tests must be in windows  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.10'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.11'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.12'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.13'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.14'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: pypy-3.11  
|  steps:  
|  \- uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2  
|  with:  
|  fetch-depth: 0  
|  persist-credentials: false  
|  \- name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}  
|  uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405 # v6.2.0  
|  with:  
|  python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}  
|  \- name: Install test requirements  
|  run: python ./devscripts/install_deps.py --include-extra test --include-extra curl-cffi  
|  \- name: Run tests  
|  timeout-minutes: 15  
|  continue-on-error: False  
|  env:  
|  source: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && github.event.before) || 'origin/master' }}  
|  target: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && github.event.after) || 'HEAD' }}  
|  shell: bash  
|  run: |  
|  flags=()  
|  # Check if a networking file is involved  
|  patterns="\  
|  ^yt_dlp/networking/  
|  ^yt_dlp/utils/networking\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_http_proxy\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_networking\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_networking_utils\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_socks\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_websockets\\.py$  
|  ^pyproject\\.toml$  
|  "  
|  if git diff --name-only "${source}" "${target}" | grep -Ef <(printf '%s' "${patterns}"); then  
|  flags+=(--flaky)  
|  fi  
|  python3 -m yt_dlp -v || true # Print debug head  
|  python3 -m devscripts.run_tests "${flags[@]}" --pytest-args '--reruns 2 --reruns-delay 3.0' core

|  fail-fast: false

|  persist-credentials: false

| permissions: {}  
|   
| concurrency:  
|  group: core-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}  
|  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}  
|   
| jobs:  
|  tests:  
|  name: Core Tests  
|  if: ${{ !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, ':ci skip') }}  
|  permissions:  
|  contents: read  
|  runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}  
|  strategy:  
|  fail-fast: false  
|  matrix:  
|  os: [ubuntu-latest]  
|  # CPython 3.10 is in quick-test  
|  python-version: ['3.11', '3.12', '3.13', '3.14', pypy-3.11]  
|  include:  
|  # atleast one of each CPython/PyPy tests must be in windows  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.10'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.11'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.12'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.13'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: '3.14'  
|  \- os: windows-latest  
|  python-version: pypy-3.11  
|  steps:  
|  \- uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2  
|  with:  
|  fetch-depth: 0  
|  persist-credentials: false  
|  \- name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}  
|  uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405 # v6.2.0  
|  with:  
|  python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}  
|  \- name: Install test requirements  
|  run: python ./devscripts/install_deps.py --include-extra test --include-extra curl-cffi  
|  \- name: Run tests  
|  timeout-minutes: 15  
|  continue-on-error: False  
|  env:  
|  source: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && github.event.before) || 'origin/master' }}  
|  target: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && github.event.after) || 'HEAD' }}  
|  shell: bash  
|  run: |  
|  flags=()  
|  # Check if a networking file is involved  
|  patterns="\  
|  ^yt_dlp/networking/  
|  ^yt_dlp/utils/networking\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_http_proxy\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_networking\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_networking_utils\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_socks\\.py$  
|  ^test/test_websockets\\.py$  
|  ^pyproject\\.toml$  
|  "  
|  if git diff --name-only "${source}" "${target}" | grep -Ef <(printf '%s' "${patterns}"); then  
|  flags+=(--flaky)  
|  fi  
|  python3 -m yt_dlp -v || true # Print debug head  
|  python3 -m devscripts.run_tests "${flags[@]}" --pytest-args '--reruns 2 --reruns-delay 3.0' core

# Include videos skipped due to download archive in playlist metadata entries #15779

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15779)

Copy link

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15779)

Copy link

Open

Open

Include videos skipped due to download archive in playlist metadata entries#15779

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/ctengel)

## Description

[](https://github.com/ctengel)

[ctengel](https://github.com/ctengel)

opened [on Jan 31, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15779#issue-3879075038)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Desired behavior:

  * User specifies a playlist URL
  * User specifies a download archive file
  * Any video in download archive gets skipped
  * Every video gets at least some basic metadata (extractor, ID, URL) included in output (via `-J` option, playlist `playlist` post-processor, return value `dict`, and/or `.info.json` file



Current behavior:

  * For non-skipped videos, extensive metadata is made available (via `-J`, to `playlist` processor, etc)
  * For skipped videos, no metadata is present whatsoever; `entries` does not have any indication of other videos; only a higher `playlist_count`



Related issues:

  * Current behavior may have been introduced with [-J with --download-archive returns undesirable 4-field-object entries #4369](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4369) (previously it may have been more similar to "desired behavior"); simply reverting related commit(s) may resolve this issue and enable this use case, but would probably cause others for other use cases. However, it provides some clues how to implement this one.
  * If [Add `--use-postprocessor` WHEN stage `before_playlist` #7034](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7034) `before_playlist` were to be implemented, it may provide an alternative way to reach a similar goal. (i.e. make entire playlist basic metadata available outside of yt-dlp prior to removing entries from download archive) Suggest evaluating whether this issue or that makes more sense for implementation.



Design alternatives:

  * Include skipped video in `entries` list with dictionary item like `"skipped": True`
  * New config option that instructs yt-dlp to include metadata for skipped videos
  * Add a new list to output (alongside, not in, `entries` list) like `"skipped_entries": [{"ie_key": "extractor", "id": "abcd", "_type": "url", "url": "https://www.extractor.com/abcd"}, {"ie_key": "extractor", "id": "efgh", "_type": "url", "url": "https://www.extractor.com/efgh"}]`



For clarity, abbreviated simulated output illustrating debug output of encountering two videos ("video1" and "video2"), but JSON output excluding "video1" included.

I am willing to work on a pull request for this but looking for feedback on the feature itself and if there is a preference for one design over another.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

🚨[IMPORTANT]🚨 KNOWN ISSUES/FAQ#3766

Copy link

Labels

[discussion/announcement](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22discussion%2Fannouncement%22)

## Description

[](https://github.com/pukkandan)

[pukkandan](https://github.com/pukkandan)

opened [on May 17, 2022](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766#issue-1238299309)

Issue body actions

Some known common issues. Make sure to always check this before opening issues. **Duplicates of these will be strictly treated as spam!**

**Useful issue tracker filters:**

[[Core Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement%2Cbug%2Ccore%3Adownloader%2Ccore%3Apost-processor%2Ccore%3Aextractor%2Ccore%3Anetworking%2Ccore%3Acookies) [[Site Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite-request%2Csite-enhancement%2Csite-bug) [[YouTube issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite%3Ayoutube) [[Good issues for new devs]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22)

## Intractable issues

  * **[[YouTube] This content isn't available, try again later. #11426](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11426)**
    * You are exceeding the rate limit. Refer to [the wiki on how to avoid](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#this-content-isnt-available-try-again-later).
  * **[Passing Youtube cookies doesn't seem to work; cookies are being invalidated quickly #8227](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8227)**
    * [How to effectively export YouTube cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies)
  * **[[youtube] Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot #10128](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10128)**
    * Your IP has been blocked by YouTube while you are logged out. You can [pass logged-in cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies); however, doing so may get your account blocked. The safer solution is to use a different IP.
    * To prevent this, [try passing a PO Token](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide), though it will not help if your IP is already blocked.
  * **[[youtube] "Video unavailable" with cookies - YouTube blocking accounts from web #10085](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10085)**
    * Your account has been blocked by YouTube, or the video is not available in your region.
    * Avoid passing cookies, or add a [sleep delay](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#workarounds) to each download.
  * **[[Youtube] Immediate HTTP Error 403 on download #11868](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11868)**
    * Not to be confused with [[YouTube] "HTTP Error 403: Forbidden" for `ios` m3u8 formats #13511](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13511), which **is fixed**

  * [[teachable] ERROR: Unable to find Video URL https://edu.ecomsuccess.pk/courses/enrolled/903296 #3564](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3564)
  * [CeskaTelevize broken #6539](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6539)
  * [iQIYI extractor can't find any video #2740](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2740)
  * [[Viu] URLs are using generic extractor instead of Viu extractor #6482](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6482)
  * [[abciview] [zee5] ERROR: Data must be padded to 16 byte boundary in CBC mode #3810](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3810)
  * [[Ixigua] ERROR: Failed to get SSR_HYDRATED_DATA #5374](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5374)
  * [Douyin always errors saying fresh cookies are needed, even when passing them #9667](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9667)
  * **[[TikTok:live] Livestreams are mistaken as "not currently live" after JSON metadata request #11921](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11921)**
  * [[tiktok] API returns empty response #13134](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13134)
  * [[vk] Failed to parse JSON (caused by JSONDecodeError("Expecting value in '': line 1 column 1 (char 0)")) #12970](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12970)
  * **[[BiliBili] No video formats found #12887](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12887)**
  * [[TikTok] One format, varying results (region-related) #15690](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15690)



# External issues

  * [ffmpeg can't seek in Youtube's iOS m3u8 streams / `--download-sections` only downloads audio #9552](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9552)
    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` "Permission denied" errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)



# FAQ

See <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ>

  * **[How to avoid Youtube's new "Super Resolution" AI-upscaled formats #15325](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15325)**
  * **[Getting deno to work in Termux. #15095 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15095#issuecomment-3544324838)**
    * Run a full Termux upgrade with `pkg update && pkg upgrade` before `pkg install deno`
  * **[[Rumble] Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden #15089](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15089)**
    * Cloudflare is blocking your IP. Follow [this answer in the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#im-getting-http-error-403-and-the-site-has-an-open-issue-on-the-tracker-thats-labeled-cloudflare-related-what-can-i-do)
  * **[[YouTube] Enhanced bitrate no longer available to download? #14133 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14133#issuecomment-3217679575)**
  * [**Filename too long**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1136#issuecomment-932077195)
    * Use `-o "%(title).150B [%(id)s].%(ext)s"`
  * **[[YouTube]`--write-comments`: "Incomplete data received. Giving up after 3 retries" warnings #15435](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15435)**
  * **[twitter: No video could be found in this tweet #14742](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14742)**
  * [[Question] odd ba* format selection? #979 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/979#issuecomment-919629354)
    * Generally do not use `ba*`
  * [Fix playlist_index's inconsistent behavior #302](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/302)
    * Check `playlist_autonumber` and `--compat-option playlist-index`
  * [yt-dlp python module not compiling with pyinstaller #3845](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3845)
    * Use `bundle/pyinstaller.py`
  * [Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issuecomment-893659460)
    * Use `--compat-option no-keep-subs`
  * [`--download-sections`/`--sponsorblock-remove` does not cut at exact point #4216](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4216) / [YouTube Clip Downloads have unintented extra beginning part with no video #5080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5080)
    * Use `--force-keyframes-at-cuts`
  * [Duplicating pull request from youtube-dl to yt-dlp #4202](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4202)
  * [How to check in browser if the video is DRM protected](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4062#issuecomment-1153474056)
  * [\--cookies-from-browser for a chrome/firefox like browser or non-default install location #2903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2903)
  * [What are yt-dlp's error codes? #4262 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4262#issuecomment-1173133105)
  * [Extractor option `language` for `crunchyrollbeta` #4640](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4640)
  * [Ability to strip Emoji from downloaded file  #4836](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4836) / [File names use "full-width" special characters: '？' vs '?' #5014](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5014)
  * [[Youtube] Extract exact timestamps #1803](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1803)
  * [[Feature Request] Crop to square thumbnail when embedding in MP3s #429 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/429#issuecomment-2282554440)
  * Download only videos with subtitles 
    * `--parse-metadata "%(subtitles.\:.0.ext|)s:^(?!\[\])(?P<has_subs>.)" -v --match-filter has_subs`
  * [How do I rename previously-downloaded files with nothing but the youtube video ID? #5692](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5692)
  * Remove specific fields from info-json - [[Suggestion] Redact `formats` in info json with an option #455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/455#issuecomment-1367741786)
  * About subtitles in mp4 container - [Convert webvtt subtitles in mp4 into useable format #5833 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5833#issuecomment-1358246240)
  * [Find the API option for a CLI argument #5859 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5859#issuecomment-1363938900)
    * Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/devscripts/cli_to_api.py>
  * [[YouTube] `youtube:skip=translated_subs` doesn't work for some videos. #3875](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3875)
  * [Youtube bestvideo and vp9 preference. #1232 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1232#issuecomment-939635345)
  * [repo: git log broken by SSH signature #7322](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7322)
  * [download comments into separate comments.json file #2372 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2372#issuecomment-1506413976)
  * [How to force a conversion to a specific video codec? #7607 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7607#issuecomment-1636960750)
  * [How to download youtube videos in mp4 format? #8880](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8880)
  * [How do I properly pass my Soundcloud oauth token to yt-dlp? #12249 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12249#issuecomment-2628937389)
  * [[youtube] 256kbps music formats not being extracted #12455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12455#issuecomment-2677077342)



**PS** : These are just the most common issues at the moment. Make sure to [search for duplicates](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) in general before opening issues. Looking at this is not an excuse to not search for other duplicates!

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I know this isn't me requesting a bug or anything like that but...

I wanna know if you can implement a detection for when you're trying to download a video/audio on a storage that's running out of space and try to warn and cancel the download!

This happens to me on my phone (specifically an unofficial GUI app (YTDLnis)) that when the download is complete, when i check for the file... it doesn't appear there!  
Tried to download using an SD Card (which i know is running out of space)...Checked the logs and it seems fine.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/VonJagdstrumel)

[VonJagdstrumel](https://github.com/VonJagdstrumel)

opened [on Jan 29, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15753#issue-3871862225)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When running `yt-dlp` under Cygwin, the `--cookies-from-browser` option fails to locate browser databases (Firefox, Chrome, etc.). This is because Cygwin's `os.path.expandvars` implementation follows POSIX conventions (expecting `$VARIABLE`) rather than Windows conventions (expecting `%VARIABLE%`).

Currently, `yt_dlp/cookies.py` uses hardcoded `%APPDATA%` and `%LOCALAPPDATA%` strings when `sys.platform` is `cygwin`, resulting in literal strings that fail to expand and cause a `FileNotFoundError`.

Here is a short demonstration :
    
    
    Python 3.12.12 (main, Oct 11 2025, 11:03:47) [GCC 13.4.0] on cygwin
    Type "help", "copyright", "credits" or "license" for more information.
    >>> import os, sys
    >>> sys.platform
    'cygwin'
    >>> os.name
    'posix'
    >>> os.path.expandvars('%APPDATA%\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles')
    '%APPDATA%\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles'
    >>> os.path.expandvars('$APPDATA\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles')
    'C:\\Users\\Steve\\AppData\\Roaming\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles'
    >>>
    

A possible fix involves checking the platform and using the appropriate variable expansion syntax for both Firefox and Chromium-based browser path logic.

I have prepared a patch ([`master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/cookies-expandvars`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/compare/master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/cookies-expandvars)) that:

  1. Uses `$VAR` syntax for Cygwin and `%VAR%` for native Win32.
  2. Uses `os.path.join` to build paths cleanly once the root environment variables are resolved.



### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    [debug] Command-line config: ['-vU', '--cookies-from-browser', 'firefox', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ']

# [Announcement] External JavaScript runtime now required for full YouTube support #15012

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012)

Copy link

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012)

Copy link

Closed

Closed

[Announcement] External JavaScript runtime now required for full YouTube support#15012

Copy link

Labels

[discussion/announcement](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22discussion%2Fannouncement%22)

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

## Description

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)

opened [on Nov 12, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012#issue-3614398875)

Issue body actions

This is a follow-up to [#14404](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14404), which announced that yt-dlp will _soon_ require an external JavaScript runtime (e.g. Deno) in order to fully support downloading from YouTube.

### With the release of [yt-dlp version `2025.11.12`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2025.11.12), external JavaScript runtime support has arrived.

### All users who intend to use yt-dlp with YouTube are strongly encouraged to install one of the supported JS runtimes.

The following JavaScript runtimes are currently supported (_in order of recommendation, from strongest to weakest_):

  1. ### Deno

     * **recommended for most users**
     * <https://deno.com/>
     * <https://github.com/denoland/deno>
       * note: _if downloading from[Deno's GitHub releases](https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases/latest), get `deno` **not** `denort`_
     * minimum Deno version supported by yt-dlp: `2.0.0`
       * _the latest version of Deno is strongly recommended_
  2. ### Node

     * <https://nodejs.org/>
     * minimum Node version supported by yt-dlp: `20.0.0`
       * _if using Node, the latest version (25+) is strongly recommended for security reasons_
  3. ### QuickJS

     * <https://bellard.org/quickjs/>
     * minimum QuickJS version supported by yt-dlp: `2023-12-9`
       * _if using QuickJS, version`2025-4-26` or later is strongly recommended for performance reasons_
  4. ### QuickJS-ng

     * <https://quickjs-ng.github.io/quickjs/>
     * all versions are supported by yt-dlp; however, **[upstream QuickJS](https://bellard.org/quickjs/) is recommended instead** for performance reasons
  5. ### Bun

     * <https://bun.com/>
     * minimum Bun version supported by yt-dlp: `1.0.31`
       * _if using Bun, the latest version is strongly recommended_



Note that only `deno` is enabled by default; all others are disabled by default for security reasons. See [the EJS wiki page](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS) for more details.

* * *

_In addition to_ the JavaScript runtime, yt-dlp also requires the [yt-dlp-ejs](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs) component in order to operate the JS runtime.

**NOTE:** This component **is already included in all of the[official yt-dlp executables](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest)**.  
Similarly, if you've installed & upgraded the yt-dlp Python package with the `default` extra (`yt-dlp[default]`), **then you already have the yt-dlp-ejs component**.

If you've installed yt-dlp another way, then please refer to [section 2 of the EJS wiki page](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS#step-2-install-ejs-challenge-solver-scripts) for more details.

* * *

Support for YouTube without a JavaScript runtime is now considered "deprecated." It does still work somewhat; however, format availability will be limited, and severely so in some cases (e.g. for logged-in users). Format availability without a JS runtime is expected to worsen as time goes on, and this will not be considered a "bug" but rather an inevitability for which there is no solution. It's also expected that, eventually, support for YouTube will not be possible at all without a JS runtime.

* * *

If you have questions, please refer to the EJS wiki page, the previous announcement's FAQ, and the README before commenting or opening a new issue:

  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS>
  * [[Announcement] Upcoming new requirements for YouTube downloads #14404](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14404)
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#dependencies>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#general-options>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#youtube-ejs>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS#plugins>



* * *

## Notes to package maintainers

If you are maintaining a downstream package of yt-dlp, we offer the following guidance:

  * The `yt-dlp` repository, source tarball, PyPI source distribution and built distribution (wheel) are still licensed under The Unlicense (public domain); however, **when the`yt-dlp-ejs` package is built, it bundles code licensed under ISC and MIT.** This is the primary reason why `yt-dlp-ejs` was split off into a [separate repository](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs) and [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/yt-dlp-ejs)

  * If `yt-dlp` is packaged as a Python package in your repository, `yt-dlp-ejs` would ideally be packaged separately

  * `yt-dlp-ejs` is technically an _optional_ Python dependency of yt-dlp, but YouTube support is deprecated without it

  * **Each version of`yt-dlp` will be pinned to a specific version of `yt-dlp-ejs` and yt-dlp will reject any other `yt-dlp-ejs` version.** Refer to yt-dlp's [`pyproject.toml`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/2025.11.12/pyproject.toml#L59) for the pinned version

  * If your repository packages `yt-dlp` _as the zipimport binary instead of as a Python package_ , you can use `make yt-dlp-extra` to build the zip executable with `yt-dlp-ejs` included. (The Makefile will look for the `yt-dlp-ejs` wheel in the `build` subdirectory, or the extracted built distribution in the `yt_dlp_ejs` subdirectory)

  * `deno`, `nodejs`, `quickjs` and/or `bun` should be _optional_ dependencies of `yt-dlp`. But again, YouTube support is deprecated without _one_ of them

  * While `yt-dlp-ejs` and the external JavaScript runtimes are currently only used with YouTube, yt-dlp's usage of these may be expanded in the future (and necessarily so)




If this guidance is insufficient, or if you are a developer integrating yt-dlp into your software and you have further questions, please open a [new GitHub issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/new?template=6_question.yml).

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

UK - but via VPN all over the world.

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading the playlist:  
<https://www.pornhub.com/playlist/341574741>  
it only downloads first few pages. I've kinda experiences similar issue in browser window where you need to scroll very slowly to load next 30/50 videos... if scrolling to quick the next block of videos in the playlist doesn't load.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

USA

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Occasionally, yt-dlp fails with HTTP 403 error when using -t mp4 option. See the verbose output. When -t mp4 option is not used, the download works and the wbem file is downloaded. If -t mp4 option is specified, the download works for a few seconds, and then it fails with HTTP 403

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Example URLs

<https://xcentric.cccb.org/en/focus/fitxa/marcel-hanoun-lete-by-aaron-cabanas/239642>  
<https://vimeo.com/725148986>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading embedded Vimeo videos, yt-dlp extracts a `player.vimeo` URL that provides no video description. This is not optimal since some of those videos have a public video page with a description available.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/Jack-Sibley)

[Jack-Sibley](https://github.com/Jack-Sibley)

opened [on Jan 30, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15773#issue-3877673532)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

JW Player supports chapters via an attached VTT track with a `kind` of `chapters` ([See docs](https://docs.jwplayer.com/players/docs/jw8-add-chapter-markers)). As an example use case, when downloading videos from Beacon, I would like to preserve this information.

From what I can tell, much of the work necessary to implement this is already covered, `_parse_jwplayer_data()` in `yt_dlp/extractor/common.py` already loops through VTT tracks (currently skipping anything that isn't of kind `captions` or `subtitles`) and there's already a VTT parser in `yt_dlp/webvtt.py` that would be sufficient for processing these files.

The only thing I can't figure out on my own is how best to download the contents of the chapters.vtt file (which is given as a url) and pass it into `parse_fragment()`. All the places where VTT tracks are normally downloaded assume they want to be saved directly into a file.

Any suggestions are appreciated.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

### So, just to be clear: Report is not about 403 error. It's about `ERROR: unable to download video data: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden` message that on the same line as downloading progress.

[](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/96221151/542319110-11720834-944f-473e-b846-c652d7116b99.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..RZqCPQzBwBOLxsJnLOUcKVOnL22v0aNzWTfCEn6Q4UI)

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

USA

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Stripchat only downloads preview video of the site, when trying to download a stream of a model.

I replaced my username with * , for privacy reasons.

ytdlp is up to date.

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/HalvorRaknes)

[HalvorRaknes](https://github.com/HalvorRaknes)

opened [on Jan 30, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15772#issue-3877235571)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Norway

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am attempting to download the most recent episodes of NRK's main daily newscast using the same command line as I normally use with minor adjustments.. 'yt-dlp' first attempts to download the most recent listed video, which is an upcoming video for tomorrow's show. This is perfectly normal according to my experience and never causes the script to halt. But then it skips all the consecutive episodes, which should be today's and yesterday's and so on shows. It indeed skips to a very old show and attempts to download that same episode again and again AS IF it was different videos.

Also, the number of pages it downloads before starting to attempt downloading videos is unusually short. It usually is around 650 pages.

Downloading the videos individually works fine. The same problem is experienced with another show ( `$ yt-dlp -I 1:6 --dateafter 20260126 https://tv.nrk.no/serie/distriktsnyheter-oestlandet`). Downloading audio files does not cause this problem (e.g. `$ yt-dlp -I 1:4 --dateafter 20260124 https://radio.nrk.no/serie/helgemorgen`).

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Hey everyone,

I noticed something strange:

When downloading to my home folder, (or any other location) everything works as expected, but when I'm trying to download to my NFS share, the download simply does not start.

Creating/modifying file on the NFS share works without any issue.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

`--add-metadata` doesn't work when downloading from [stiftung-imai.de](https://stiftung-imai.de/en/video/catalogue). This has to be caused by the video extensions just being derived from the numerical video IDs (filename example: `Schnittpunkte ｜ Stiftung imai (1) [1012-1].1012`), because the issue doesn't appear when the videos are downloaded as `mkv`.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Example URLs

  * Single video: <https://www.palestinefilminstitute.org/en/aftermath>
  * Playlist: <https://www.palestinefilminstitute.org/en/provoked-narratives>



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

[Embed link](https://cdn.palestinefilminstitute.org/watch/8a53509aefaf4b34a0f82b15463390cd/)

A downloadable m3u8 URL can be extracted with [_The Stream Detector_](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/hls-stream-detector):  
<https://cdn.palestinefilminstitute.org/share/hls.m3u8?token=8a53509aefaf4b34a0f82b15463390cd>

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Example URLs

These are only the extensions I have become aware of so far:  
[`dv`](https://archive.org/download/out_20190702): <https://archive.org/details/out_20190702>  
[`ts`](https://archive.org/download/HDNETTestPattern1080iHDTVDD5.1MPEG2TrollHD): <https://archive.org/details/HDNETTestPattern1080iHDTVDD5.1MPEG2TrollHD>  
[`m2ts`](https://archive.org/download/foehn): <https://archive.org/details/foehn>  
[`mpeg`](https://archive.org/download/FENSTER_HOF): <https://archive.org/details/FENSTER_HOF>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Some videos on archive.org have original formats with extensions that are apparently not supported by yt-dlp (I guess?), leading to an inferior `derivative` format getting downloaded.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Region

_No response_

### Example URLs

<https://www.nzonscreen.com/title/real-time-a-light-sound-environment-1971>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

As the highest quality, yt-dlp currently only downloads a 742 × 540p version of this video (albeit listed as `1980x1080` in the format table), whereas the browser player has an actual HD playback option, also listed therein with a bigger file size. And I indeed get a Full HD version not accessible with yt-dlp when I download the video using the m3u8 URL extracted with [_The Stream Detector_](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/hls-stream-detector).

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I'm running yt-dlp version **2023.03.04** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update)) or later (specify commit)
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When trying to download shorts it seems that extractor treats url like a playlist instead of a single video

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When using the QuickJS provider under a Cygwin environment, the underlying runtime fails to execute because it cannot find or access the temporary file containing the JavaScript code.

The core of the issue is that Python, when run under Cygwin, provides a POSIX-style path (e.g., `/tmp/file.js`) for the temporary file. However, the QuickJS runtime (`qjs.exe`) running as a native Windows (win32) application only understands Windows NT paths (e.g., `C:\Users\...\AppData\Local\Temp\file.js`).

This mismatch prevents the native QuickJS executable from correctly locating and opening the temporary file specified through its `--script` option, leading to runtime failure when running the challenge solver.

I suggest two distinct approaches to resolve this issue:

  * The first approach involves manually checking a list of common Windows NT temporary directories (such as `$USERPROFILE\AppData\Local\Temp` or `$SYSTEMROOT\Temp`) until one is found that allows for the creation of a temporary file (cf. [`master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/well-known`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/compare/master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/well-known)).
  * The second approach uses the Cygwin API (specifically `cygwin_create_path` from `cygwin1.dll`) to programmatically convert the POSIX-style path returned by Python's `tempfile` module into the equivalent Windows NT path (cf. [`master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/posix2win`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/compare/master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/posix2win)).



### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Example URLs

  * [https://www.youtube.com/@슈삼](https://www.youtube.com/@%EC%8A%88%EC%82%BC)



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When trying to extract the `uploader`, `uploader_id`, and `uploader_url` fields from a video by the user `@슈삼`, I get `NA` as the output, not the data I'm requesting.

This might be because the username uses asian characters, but I've tried with other videos from other users that use those characters and I don't have this problem. (e.g `YBH8N7ZWdHM`, `BxinqUyx40U`)

When I run the command:
    
    
    yt-dlp --print uploader,uploader_id,uploader_url ziJE1deJZDY
    

The output is:
    
    
    superssammu
    NA
    NA
    

yt-dlp version: 2025.11.11.005312

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/imgradeone)

[imgradeone](https://github.com/imgradeone)

opened [on Jul 9, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13676#issue-3216622506)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Hong Kong

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

BBC Audio (bbc.com/audio) is an audio platform for listeners outside UK (not to be confused with BBC Sounds, which will be closed for listeners outside UK in July 21st), and yt-dlp used [bbc] extractor to handle URLs from BBC Audio. However, I got an `Unable to extract playlist data` error when attempting to download content from BBC Audio.

URL in this issue: <https://www.bbc.com/audio/play/m002d11m>

Tried without logging in on my browser, and the content played normally.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp defaults to the /videos tab when extracting channel metadata. That works if a channel _has_ videos. But if a channel does not have videos, the metadata extraction fails, even though I see yt-dlp going into /shorts and /streams in the debug output.

Could that be handled on yt-dlp's side? Or is there a better command to just extract the channel metadata more reliably for _any_ channel?

Example for a successful channel metadata extraction:
    
    
    yt-dlp -vU https://www.youtube.com/@RyanGeorge --dump-single-json --playlist-items "0,0"

Meanwhile specifying the streams URL will correctly extract all accessible metadata: `https://www.youtube.com/@ModBotArmyy/streams`.

I understand that this would fail if I explicitly specify the /videos tab and the channel has no videos, that would be expected.

The ideal scenario IMO would be if yt-dlp could detect that correctly and show the complete metadata, even without videos. That's also what happens visually, when you browse the YT interface.

If there is a good reason against that, I understand, and we'll be able to work around it. But I thought I raise it here.

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Hungary

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Mediaklikk has srt format subtitles available for several videos. yt-dlp currently can't detect it.

The url structure changed from the previous format, adding a category into the first part of the url.

Old url example: <https://mediaklikk.hu/video/hazajaro-bilo-hegyseg-verocei-barangolas-a-drava-menten/>  
New url example: <https://mediaklikk.hu/ismeretterjeszto/video/2026/01/29/ismeretterjeszto/hazajaro-also-csallokoz-csicsotol-csiliznyaradig/>

Category get's detected from the new url format not the video display_id.

Currently wrong (with category, "sorozat" detected as display_id instead "koronas-sas-3-evad-398-resz"):
    
    
    [MediaKlikk] Extracting URL: https://mediaklikk.hu/sorozat-0/video/2026/01/30/sorozat/koronas-sas-3-evad-398-resz/
    [MediaKlikk] sorozat: Downloading webpage
    [MediaKlikk] 9315846: Downloading webpage
    [MediaKlikk] 9315846: Downloading m3u8 information
    

Correct way (with category):
    
    
    [MediaKlikk] Extracting URL: https://mediaklikk.hu/sorozat-0/video/2026/01/30/sorozat/koronas-sas-3-evad-398-resz/
    [MediaKlikk] koronas-sas-3-evad-398-resz: Downloading webpage
    [MediaKlikk] 9315846: Downloading webpage
    [MediaKlikk] 9315846: Downloading m3u8 information
    

Currently working (without category):
    
    
    [MediaKlikk] Extracting URL: https://mediaklikk.hu/video/2026/01/20/csinaljuk-a-fesztivalt-5-evad-szabo-mate-2/
    [MediaKlikk] csinaljuk-a-fesztivalt-5-evad-szabo-mate-2: Downloading webpage
    [MediaKlikk] 9284763: Downloading webpage
    [MediaKlikk] 9284763: Downloading m3u8 information
    

Some video link examples that are worldwide accessible, not just Hungary:  
<https://mediaklikk.hu/ismeretterjeszto/video/2026/01/29/ismeretterjeszto/hazajaro-also-csallokoz-csicsotol-csiliznyaradig/>  
<https://mediaklikk.hu/sorozat-0/video/2026/01/30/sorozat/koronas-sas-3-evad-398-resz/>  
<https://mediaklikk.hu/video/2026/01/20/csinaljuk-a-fesztivalt-5-evad-szabo-mate-2/>

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading a video from `developer.apple.com`, subtitles are missing, even though they are displayed when viewing the same video via a regular web browser.

(sorry if I've opened the issue in the wrong place - first time!)

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

France

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Some bandcamp `/music` pages are incorrectly recognized as empty. The new (third?) page format puts the links inside a `<div class="ipCellLabel">`.

Since i have a local patch that addresses that issue i may as well offer it:  
Adding `yield from traverse_obj(webpage, ({find_elements(cls='ipCellLabel', html=True)}, ..., {find_element(tag='a', html=True)}, {extract_attributes}, 'href', {str}))` to the `_yield_items` method of `BandcampUserIE` along with the required import of `find_elements` seems to work.

The log provided was generated without my patch, so my small test case shows no entries because the generator is empty. With the patch i get twenty four entries, one of which is for a track and the other are for albums.

The URLs i know cause that issue:

  * <https://jmrmusic.bandcamp.com/music/>
  * <https://theflashbulb.bandcamp.com/music/>
  * <https://zef-music.bandcamp.com/music/>



### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below
